product_metadata.title: Large Multipurpose  Reversible Cutting Board for Kitchen with Deep Juice Groove Organic Acacia Wood cutting board- Chopping Boards-Cheese Board -Charcuterie Board:16×12×1.45inch
features: 1.Excellent wood performance：Selected quality acacia wood from rigorous processing，Not easily deformed，No crack，Not moldy，Zero - formaldehyde，acacia Wood is stable and durable。

2.Large size，Deep juice groove,Reversible：There's plenty of room to work with the ingredients，and 1.46in thick butcher block style board allows for stability while cutting。one side have groove can collect fruit and vegetable juices，Keep the countertops clean，The reverse side have built-in compartments，where to put temporarily the mashed garlic, diced veggies, cheese, etc. No more mess on the board, no more bowls and plates around the board。
3.Multi-purpose:Not just for cutting food，hidden handles on both sides, convenient for cutting boards to be used as plates, used as trays for cheese, bread, etc。
4.Knife partner：Acacia wood structure fine uniform, high density, can effectively protect the blade, so that your tool is not easy to blunt
5.Solve the problem of gift giving：When you're struggling to prepare gifts for a housewarming, wedding, birthday, Christmas, etc., our cutting board can help you, so we use a gift box to wrap
description: Attention ★After receiving the goods, clear water wash, don't bubble water exposure ★Rinse and wipe dry after use at ordinary times, erect or hang placed ventilated dry place ★Regular nursing regularly use woody vegetable oil (olive oil、 coconut oil) to the surface of the cutting board, to extend the wood, repair tool ★Cutting board regularly to disinfect clean, usable powder with lemon and salt scrub, or use white vinegar sprinkled on the surface of the cutting board, stay a few minutes and then rinse, dry, for good Because this is a wooden product, we will not change the natural nature of the wood when we make it, so there will be natural color difference,Sometimes it has knots. This is not a flaw, but a gift from nature.
